document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The  following  spring,  you  embark  on  another  expedition, 
following  your  map.  You  make  the  biggest  Canadian  gold 
strike of the decade. A Sudbury-based mining company buys 
out your share of the claim for an extraordinary fee. Thereafter, 
you are able to devote your life to privately financed research.

However,  the  Hanninah  never  truly  becomes  developed. 
Trouble  plagues  the  mining  company.  Increased  human 
penetration of the area does not dispel the stories of menace 
but  actually  increases  them.  In  the  second  year,  a  ghastly 
incident  shadows  the  enterprise,  when  the  bodies  of  12 
miners are discovered, murdered by decapitation. The heads 
are never found.

The mine closes at the onset of the Great Depression and 
does not reopen.
The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
